            component = [(r, c)]

                        q.append((ny, nx))
                        component.append((ny, nx))

code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if seen[r][c]:
                continue
            value = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen[r][c] = True
            cells = [(r, c)]
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx] == value:
                        seen[ny][nx] = True
                        q.append((ny, nx))
                        cells.append((ny, nx))
            components.append((value, cells))
    small = {cell for value, cells in components if len(cells) <= 2 for cell in cells}
    large = []
    for value, cells in components:
        if len(cells) > 2 and value != background:
            ys = [y for y, x in cells]
            xs = [x for y, x in cells]
            box_area = (max(ys)-min(ys)+1) * (max(xs)-min(xs)+1)
            density = len(cells) / box_area
            if density >= 0.8:
                large.append((value, min(ys), max(ys), min(xs), max(xs), density))
    for y, x in small:
        neighbors = [grid[ny][nx]
                     for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1))
                     if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in small]
        counts = Counter(neighbors)
        ordered = counts.most_common()
        if len(ordered) > 1 and ordered[0][1] == ordered[1][1]:
            fills = [obj for obj in large if obj[1] <= y <= obj[2] and obj[3] <= x <= obj[4]]
            replacement = max(fills, key=lambda obj: (obj[5], counts[obj[0]]))[0] if fills else background
        else:
            replacement = ordered[0][0]
        out[y][x] = replacement
    return out
'''
